snippet.title: Gears of War: Reloaded - Gameplay Trailer - 4K | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Gears of War: Reloaded is a celebration of one of gaming’s most iconic franchises—rebuilt with 4K resolution, up to120 FPS support, and fully modernized multiplayer. Featuring cross-play and cross-progression across platforms, this is the definitive way to experience the game that started it all.

Coming August 26th, 2025. Play it day one with Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass.

Pre-order now for access to the Exclusive Multiplayer Beta as well as the Adam Fenix and Anya Stroud Character Skins for use in multiplayer. https://www.xbox.com/games/store/gears-of-war-reloaded/9p8ps6993lsl  

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
